context: Volo is strapped to a chair on a dockside cart that’s been rigged with explosives, and a visible trail of alcohol runs from the angry crowd to the cart. Agitator Churg Elvek has publicly condemned him as a liar and “fearmonger,” quieting the mob to deliver a sermon-like denunciation. Volo, a well-known—if embellishing and self-promoting—scholar, pleads for a chance to explain, but his reputation has already turned the crowd against him. One agitator holds a torch and finally drops it onto the alcohol trail at the end of the exchange, implying imminent ignition and a staged, fiery execution.
